Module.Event.Field.Sequence.Tip: Unique event number. Building/unit occupation events and other events' related-event field refer to events by this number (buildings and units can only refer to 1–255)
Module.Event.Field.RelatedEvent.Tip: Sequence of the related event (0 = none). The low 16 bits are the sequence, the high 16 bits an extra parameter (1–6 in stock maps); 0x notation is accepted
Module.Event.Field.TriggerCondition.Tip: How the event is triggered; pick from the drop-down (TriggerList in setting.txt): 0=On capture, 1=On unit, 2=On turn, 4=Chained
Module.Event.Field.TriggerEvent.Tip: What happens when the event fires; pick from the drop-down (EventList in setting.txt): 0=Morale up, 1=Morale down, 2=Morale collapse, 3=Chaos, 4=Show dialogue, 6=Change faction AI policy, 7=Change camp, 8=Faction attacks toward a target, 10=Grant economy, 11=Grant industry, 12=Grant technology
Module.Event.Field.TriggerLegion.Tip: Faction that triggers the event: enter the faction's turn-order number (ActionId, not its list position); 0 = not set
Module.Event.Field.AffectedLegion.Tip: Faction affected by the event: enter the faction's turn-order number (ActionId, not its list position); 0 = not set
Module.Event.Field.CampChange.Tip: Value whose meaning depends on the effect (stored as "camp change"): Change camp = new camp, Change AI policy = new policy, Attacks toward a target = target hex index (row × map width + column), Grant economy/industry/technology = amount
Module.Event.Field.Reserved.Tip: Reserved field (0 in almost all stock maps)
Module.Event.Field.TriggerRound.Tip: Turn on which the event fires (used by On turn)
Module.Event.Field.EndSegment.Tip: Default end marker (bytes 00 CC CC CC), shown in hex as 0xCCCCCC00
Module.Event.Error.NotNumber: {0}: enter an integer (decimal, or hex starting with 0x)
Module.Event.NotOnMap: Events are not placed on hexes; delete them by sequence or list position
Module.Event.Msg.Empty: There are no events to select
Module.Event.Msg.SequenceExists: An event with sequence {0} already exists
Module.Event.Msg.Duplicated: Duplicated event {0} as a new event: sequence {1}
Module.Event.Msg.Retargeted: References to sequence {0} now point to {1}: related events {2}, buildings {3}, units {4}
Module.Event.Msg.RetargetByteLimit: (building/unit occupation events can only hold 1–255; the new sequence is out of range, so they were left unchanged)
Module.Event.Check.DuplicateSequence: Sequence {0} is shared by {1} events; references by sequence (building/unit occupation events, related events) are ambiguous
Module.Event.Check.MissingTriggerLegion: Event #{0}: trigger faction {1} does not match any faction (this field holds a turn-order number)
Module.Event.Check.MissingAffectedLegion: Event #{0}: affected faction {1} does not match any faction (this field holds a turn-order number)
Module.Event.Check.MissingRelatedEvent: Event #{0}: related event #{1} does not exist
Module.Event.Check.UnreferencedOccupatio: Event #{0}: triggered on capture, but no building's occupation event points to it
Module.Event.Check.TargetOutsideMap: Event #{0}: attack target hex index {1} is outside the map ({2}×{3})
Module.Event.Check.UnexpectedEndSegment: Event #{0}: end marker is {1}, not the stock 0xCCCCCC00 (the event block was probably read from the wrong offset; this event's data is unreliable)
